text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Mejiro McQueen and I are on set for a popular TV show.

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: Here's today's guest for Running in Style.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My name is… Mejiro McQueen. Thank you for having me on the show.

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: You can't speak the name Mejiro without recognizing its prestige! Our episode with the venerable head of your family broke viewership records!

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: Fans enjoyed the rare opportunity to see a different side of her. We're all excited to be talking to you today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! As a proud member of the Mejiro family, I shall do my best to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must provide my answers with thought and care befitting the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen seems more stiff than usual as the filming proceeds…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-in short! I must fulfill the dearest… dearest wish of… the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: I-is that right? Powerful words indeed. I can really… feel the spirit behind them…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes! I want to show… N-no, I shall show… everyone that I am ready to run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh… It's no use. These sorts of answers don't do justice to the dignity of the Mejiro name…

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: Umm… Why don't we take a break? I'm sure you could use a little bit of a refresher right about now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: Oh, no need to apologize! We've got you on for quite the lengthy session, after all. Please, take some time to recharge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh… This isn't going well. I thought I was used to being on camera by now, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-is that so? Yes… you're probably right. However, I can't rid myself of these thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This outfit is a sign of my resolve and my duty. I want to demonstrate that to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Besides… I'm doing this for the fans who are cheering me on. I must conduct myself in a manner befitting the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then, when I think of all this, well… my words seem to get stuck in my throat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's gotten herself all worked up. At this point, the best thing to do is to help her relax.
choice_data_list: Why don't you go for a quick run?
Why don't you eat something sweet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What?! This may be a break, but we're still filming! My hair would get all disheveled!
choice_data_list: There'll be time to fix it! C'mon, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! G-good grief…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Phew… How strange. It felt as though both my body and mind were shedding weight as I ran.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Wow! I captured your run just now! I'd love to put it on the air if possible. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha?! B-but… My hair is all disheveled, and… I'm sure I looked terrible.

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: Consider it a request from me too! I could really feel your passion for running while I watched!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes… please put it on the air. If it conveys my passion, then nothing would make me happier!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Days later, Mejiro McQueen's invigorating run garners a huge response from viewers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: S-something sweet?! Unthinkable!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This is an important shoot, so I must be perfect! Allowing myself to be distracted by a snack would be—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A-all right, fine! They say sweets serve well as a pick-me-up, so… Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch… Ahh… The macaron is melting in my mouth…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe, delicious. Both my body and mind feel more relaxed now.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Wow! What a natural, beautiful smile! I'd love to put that on the air, if you wouldn't mind. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wha?! M-my expression just now?!

text_block_list.name: Presenter
text_block_list.text: Consider it a request from me, too! I'm sure it'll make your fans happy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Very well, then! I shall allow it, for the sake of my fans!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However, um… I-it's rather embarrassing. Would you please only air a short clip?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Days later, the sight of Mejiro McQueen enjoying sweets garners a huge response from viewers.
